def trigger_columns(relid, numbers, columns, identities):
    """Bind ordered trigger attnums to exact non-dropped column identities."""
    require(type(relid) is int and relid > 0 and type(numbers) is list)
    seen, result = set(), []
    for number in numbers:
        require(type(number) is int and number > 0 and number not in seen)
        seen.add(number)
        key = ("pg_class", relid, number)
        column = columns.get((relid, number))
        identity = identities.get(key)
        require(column is not None and column["attisdropped"] is False)
        require(type(identity) is dict and type(identity.get("identity")) is str
                and bool(identity["identity"]))
        result.append(deepcopy(identity))
    return result

def column_type_invariant(row):
    """Dropped columns have no type identity; all live columns have one."""
    dropped, type_oid = row["attisdropped"], row["atttypid"]
    if (type(dropped) is not bool or type(type_oid) is not int or
            not 0 <= type_oid <= 4294967295 or
            (type_oid == 0) != dropped):
        raise ValueError("invalid CI-only source reference: COLUMN_TYPE_INVARIANT")


def require_edge_identities(edges, identities):
    """Fail before source output, with bounded address-only diagnostics."""
    absent = []
    for edge in sorted(edges):
        for side, endpoint in (("source", edge[:3]), ("target", edge[3:6])):
            if endpoint not in identities:
                cat, oid, subid = endpoint
                require(cat in FIELDS and type(oid) is int and type(subid) is int)
                dep = edge[6]
                dependency_type = dep if (type(dep) is str and
                    (dep == "declared" or re.fullmatch(r"(?:shared:)?[A-Za-z]", dep))) else "OTHER_DEPENDENCY_TYPE"
                absent.append({"reason": "EDGE_ENDPOINT_WITHOUT_IDENTITY", "side": side,
                               "catalog": cat, "oid": oid, "subid": subid,
                               "dependency_type": dependency_type})
    if absent:
        absent.sort(key=canonical)
        evidence = {"count": len(absent), "sha256": digest(canonical(absent).encode()),
                    "first": absent[:16]}
        raise ValueError("invalid CI-only source reference: " + canonical(evidence))

def restore_trigger_source(raw, path):
    recipe = (ROOT / "docs/CI_SOURCE_REFERENCE_PG_TRIGGER_CORRECTION_LITERALS_20261029.json").read_bytes()
    assert hashlib.sha256(recipe).hexdigest() == TRIGGER_RECIPE_SHA
    plan = json.loads(recipe)
    assert set(plan) == {"format", "parent", "files"}
    assert plan["format"] == "EXACT_COUNTED_TEST_ONLY_PG_TRIGGER_LITERAL_INVERSES"
    assert plan["parent"] == TRIGGER_PARENT and set(plan["files"]) == TRIGGER_PATHS
    assert {name: len(pairs) for name, pairs in plan["files"].items()} == {
        "tests/reader_source_reference.py": 10,
        "tests/reader_source_variants.py": 2,
        "tests/test_reader_source_variants_preservation.py": 4,
    }
    assert all(type(pair) is dict and set(pair) == {"old", "new"}
               and type(pair["old"]) is str and type(pair["new"]) is str
               and pair["new"] for pairs in plan["files"].values() for pair in pairs)
    assert path in TRIGGER_PATHS
    for pair in reversed(plan["files"][path]):
        old, new = pair["old"].encode(), pair["new"].encode()
        assert raw.count(new) == 1
        raw = raw.replace(new, old, 1)
    return raw

def test_all990_c7_whole_bytes_and_modes_remain_exact_after_trigger_inverse():
    delta = subprocess.check_output(
        ["git", "diff", "--name-status", TRIGGER_PARENT + "..HEAD"], cwd=ROOT
    ).decode().splitlines()
    assert set(delta) == {
        "A\tdocs/CI_SOURCE_REFERENCE_PG_TRIGGER_CORRECTION_LITERALS_20261029.json",
        "M\ttests/reader_source_reference.py",
        "M\ttests/reader_source_variants.py",
        "A\ttests/test_reader_source_trigger.py",
        "M\ttests/test_reader_source_variants_preservation.py",
    } and len(delta) == 5
    records = subprocess.check_output(["git", "ls-tree", "-r", "-z", TRIGGER_PARENT], cwd=ROOT).split(b"\0")
    records = [r for r in records if r]
    assert len(records) == 990
    for record in records:
        identity, name = record.split(b"\t", 1)
        mode, kind, expected = identity.decode().split()
        path = ROOT / name.decode()
        assert kind == "blob"
        if mode == "120000":
            assert path.is_symlink()
            raw = os.readlink(path).encode()
        else:
            assert path.is_file() and not path.is_symlink() and stat.S_ISREG(path.stat().st_mode)
            assert bool(path.stat().st_mode & 0o111) == (mode == "100755")
            raw = path.read_bytes()
            if name.decode() in TRIGGER_PATHS:
                raw = restore_trigger_source(raw, name.decode())
        assert hashlib.sha1(b"blob " + str(len(raw)).encode() + b"\0" + raw).hexdigest() == expected, name
